# Compression fixtures

`quad-draco.gltf` is original project data generated by `node scripts/generate-draco-fixture.mjs`. It contains a four-vertex indexed quad with float positions/normals and normalized unsigned-byte colors. The encoded payload is a data URI, so tests stay offline.

`2d_etc1s.ktx2` and `2d_uastc.ktx2` are the small mipmapped test textures from the [Three.js r180 KTX2 examples](https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/tree/r180/examples/textures/ktx2). They exercise real Basis transcode paths, not mocked decoder output. The upstream repository distributes these examples under its [MIT license](https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/blob/r180/LICENSE); the license is reproduced in `THREE-LICENSE.txt`.

Meshopt streams are generated in memory with the test-only encoder entry point of the existing meshoptimizer dependency. No network requests are needed for this suite.
